decision.reason: The user asked to cut rc.38 without a benchmark round so the release branch carries the gzipped Relate module from #167 and every file in the plugin folder is under the Claude plugin directory's 5 MiB limit, so the submission can be validated again. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
